'''2012 Canadian Nationals Matthew Harrison-Trainor LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] at [[2012 Canadian Nationals]] (Nationals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Username:''' Blarg
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Nationals
